notes.title: Alternative Keys To Numpad-Update
notes.content:
Hello guys. I recently learned that a lot of people use a keyboard without a numpad, lol bummer. So I added alternative key configs to the game. You can change key settings from the Options menu. Have Fun :)


T Y U          ---------           7 8 9
G H J     --------- 4 5 6
B N M    --------      1 2 3
